def dots():
    from collections import defaultdict
    d = defaultdict(list)
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:

            d[n['color']].append(tuple(n['boundary'][0]))
    return {k: len(v) for k,v in d.items()}
print('before:', dots())
action(['DOWN']*10 + ['LEFT']*3)
print('after X move:', dots(), 'level', current_frame.level)
W = [tuple(n['boundary'][0]) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W']
print('W:', W)
</parameter>
</function>
